Thanks everyone for a productive session today. Quick recap and action items from the live run (notes based on the session recording and the CLI runner output):

Summary of the run (15-minute steady-state):
- Test payload: 15 prompts from Lumenica dataset (avg tokens: 120)
- Concurrency: 8 simulated clients
- Observed throughput: 210 qps (aggregate)
- Median latency: 85 ms/token; p95: 420 ms/token
- Peak GPU util: 78% on the baseline model variant

Immediate observations:
- Prompt prefixing reduced token churn for multi-turn prompts; recommended standardization of 3 prompt templates.
- Routing to the quantized variant reduced cost by ~28% with a 12% increase in p95 latency — acceptable trade for non-critical endpoints.
- KV cache warmed after ~3 requests; cache hit rate during the run averaged 62%.

Action items (owner — target):
- Dev: upload raw runner output and trimmed CSV (load-test-output.csv) and session recording to drive — by 2027-04-17EOD
- Marissa: produce prompt-template guide + suggested routing policy by 2027-04-20
- Jordan: consolidate commercial follow-ups (options for Dedicated burst capacity and pricing delta) — by 2027-04-21
- Lumenica (Olivia): confirm the two production endpoints and whether you want routing-based safe-fallbacks enabled — by 2027-04-19

Attachments: load-test-output.csv (trimmed), session-recording.mp4 (30m clipped highlights) — links uploaded to the shared drive.

If folks are good with a short follow-up to walk through the prompt-template guide and the cost/latency tradeoffs, we suggested a 45m session next week. Proposed slots: Tue Apr 20 09:00–09:45 or Wed Apr 21 11:00–11:45 (PST).
